title: 1RB1LB_1LC0RD_0LE1LA_0RF1RA_1LE0LA_---0RB: the right end followed exactly to depth 12,000
text: Cutting the window of last cells only where it reads 1 1 makes each entry deterministic, so the last 12,000 cells can be followed exactly until they repeat: no lone 1, no halt, and a profile that travels 4 cells per right-end cycle. All short segments, where every bulk 10 defect was born, lie inside it; what is left is long segments deep in the bulk.
